appearance.subtle: Their hair is unusually thick, and there is more of it on the backs of their hands than there was.
appearance.obvious: Coarse dark hair covers their forearms and the back of their neck, dense as pelt.
appearance.extreme: They are furred. Thick, fast-growing, and cropped raggedly wherever it got in the way.

description: Dense, coarse hair growing fast over most of you. Warm. Constant work.
name: Thickened Hair
